name: Addiction
description: A chemical, biological, or psychological dependency on a substance or intense stimulus.
body:
# Addiction

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 3 / 6 / 9 BP  
**Type**: Psychological / Physical

## Description
A chemical, biological, or psychological dependency on a substance or intense stimulus.

## Mechanics & Severity
### Tiers & Effects
- **Minor (3 BP)**: A bad habit (tobacco, alcohol, mild gambling). Suffer **-2 to Will saves** if denied within 24 hours.
- **Moderate (6 BP)**: Serious dependency (hallucinogens, painkillers, hard narcotics). Going 24 hours without inflicts the **Sickened** condition (`-2` to all checks) until indulged.
- **Major (9 BP)**: Debilitating addiction (rare combat stims, neural-jacking). Withdrawal begins after 12 hours. The character rolls **all checks with Disadvantage** and takes **1 Constitution damage per day** until indulged or detoxed.

# Adversary

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 1 to 10 BP  
**Type**: Social / Background

## Description
An individual rival or powerful organization actively hunting, harassing, or seeking to ruin the character.

## Mechanics & Severity
### Tiers & Effects
- **Individual Adversary (1-5 BP)**:
  - *1-2 BP*: Nuisance or rival of equal power level.
  - *3-5 BP*: Superior hunter, assassin, or nemesis who actively tracks the character.
- **Organizational Adversary (5-10 BP)**:
  - *5-7 BP*: Local gang, sector police precinct, or planetary guild.
  - *8-10 BP*: Galaxy-spanning megacorporation (Syndicate), Imperial Inquisition (Impyrium), or interstellar crime syndicate.
description: An individual rival or powerful organization actively hunting, harassing, or seeking to ruin the character.
name: Adversary

body:
# Bodily Age

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 5 / 10 BP  
**Type**: Physical

## Description
The character is outside the physical prime for their species, suffering bodily limitations.

## Mechanics & Severity
### Tiers & Effects
- **Child (10 BP)**: 7-12ish typical human years. **-1 Strength, -1 Agility, -1 Stamina** (Choose two). Small stature, physically undeveloped.
- **Teen (5 BP)**: 12-16ish typical human years. **-1 Strength, -1 Agility, or -1 Stamina** (Choose one). Awkward growth phases.
- **Old (5 BP)**: 60-90ish typical human years. **-1 Strength, -1 Agility, or -1 Stamina** (Choose one). Aching joints and slower reflexes.
- **Venerable (10 BP)**: 90+ typical human years. **-1 Strength, -1 Agility, -1 Stamina** (Choose two). Physically frail but rich in experience.

name: Clown
body:
# Clown

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 2 BP  
**Type**: Social

## Description
A known compulsive jokester, prankster, or class clown who struggles to project authority.

## Mechanics & Severity
### Mechanics
- **-2 Penalty** on all checks to be taken seriously (Intimidation, formal Persuasion, battlefield Command).
- NPCs naturally assume the character is joking, bluffing, or being sarcastic.

# Covetous

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 3 / 6 / 9 BP  
**Type**: Psychological

## Description
An overwhelming compulsion toward Greed (Money), Lechery (Lust), Ambition (Power), or Conspicuousness (Fame).

## Mechanics & Severity
### Tiers & Effects
- **Compulsion Trigger**: When presented with the object of desire, make a **Will Save (DC 15 + Severity)** to avoid acting impulsively.
- **Minor (3 BP)**: Grumbles and complains bitterly if denied.
- **Moderate (6 BP)**: Takes dangerous tactical risks or commits social faux pas to acquire the prize.
- **Major (9 BP)**: Will steal, betray allies, or enter combat to satisfy the craving.
description: An overwhelming compulsion toward Greed (Money), Lechery (Lust), Ambition (Power), or Conspicuousness (Fame).

# Dependent

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 3 / 6 / 9 BP  
**Type**: Social

## Description
Responsible for the continuous protection, feeding, and medical safety of a non-combatant NPC ward.

## Mechanics & Severity
### Tiers & Effects
- **Capable (3 BP)**: Ward feeds and dresses themselves but needs protection in combat (spouse, teenage apprentice).
- **Needy (6 BP)**: Ward requires daily assistance, supervision, and guidance (young child, frail elder).
- **Dependent (9 BP)**: Ward is completely helpless or requires expensive medical upkeep/stasis pod support (infant, comatose patient).

name: Disability
description: Missing limbs, paralysis, or severe mechanical impairment of bodily motor function.
body:
# Disability

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 3 / 6 / 9 / 18 BP  
**Type**: Physical

## Description
Missing limbs, paralysis, or severe mechanical impairment of bodily motor function.

## Mechanics & Severity
### Tiers & Effects
- **Minor (3 BP)**: Missing a Hand or Foot. `-2` to Athletics/Dexterity tasks with that limb; reduced movement if foot.
- **Major (6 BP)**: Missing a full Limb (Arm or Leg). Cannot use two-handed gear/shields (Arm); movement speed halved (Leg).
- **Severe (9 BP)**: Two Limbs missing or Paraplegic (Legs paralyzed). Requires wheelchair, hover-rig, or cybernetics.
- **Crippling (18 BP)**: Quadriplegic or all limbs missing. Requires full-body life-support chassis or prosthetics.

description: Unmistakable physical marks, alien coloration, cybernetic glow, or monstrous traits that make blending in impossible.
body:
# Distinctive Features

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 3 / 6 / 9 BP  
**Type**: Physical / Social

## Description
Unmistakable physical marks, alien coloration, cybernetic glow, or monstrous traits that make blending in impossible.

## Mechanics & Severity
### Tiers & Effects
- **Disguisable (3 BP)**: Large facial scar, distinct tattoo, exotic hair. Can be hidden with standard Disguise check.
- **Not-Disguisable (6 BP)**: Extra eye cluster, bioluminescent blue skin in human cities, 7-foot height. Disguise checks roll with Disadvantage.
- **Very Obvious (9 BP)**: Blazing energy aura, stone carapace, horrific mutation. Stealth and Disguise impossible in populated areas.
name: Distinctive Features

description: Severe emotional volatility, mood swings, rage triggers, or trauma-induced freezing under pressure.
body:
# Emotional Issues

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 3 / 6 / 9 / 12 BP  
**Type**: Psychological

## Description
Severe emotional volatility, mood swings, rage triggers, or trauma-induced freezing under pressure.

## Mechanics & Severity
### Tiers & Effects
- **Minor (3 BP)**: Mood swings. `-2` penalty to social interactions when under stress.
- **Moderate (6 BP)**: Outbursts or deep withdrawal. Make **Will Save (DC 15)** under duress or become *Stunned* for 1 round.
- **Major (9 BP)**: Debilitating hysteria or catatonia. Make **Will Save (DC 20)** at start of any round where damage is taken to act normally.
- **Severe (12 BP)**: Crippling instability. Permanent **-2 to Will saves**. Must pass **Will Save (DC 18)** at start of each combat turn or become *Panicked*, *Paralyzed*, or *Staggered*.

# Extreme Morality

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 4 / 8 / 12 BP  
**Type**: Psychological / Metaphysical

## Description
Unshakeable moral dogma aligned with cosmic poles (Good, Evil, Law, Chaos) that the character cannot violate.

## Mechanics & Severity
### Tiers & Effects
- **Minor (4 BP)**: Refuses to perform actions contrary to personal cosmic alignment.
- **Moderate (8 BP)**: Actively intervenes to stop allies or bystanders from violating moral code.
- **Major (12 BP)**: Violently opposes moral antithesis, even facing certain death.
description: Unshakeable moral dogma aligned with cosmic poles (Good, Evil, Law, Chaos) that the character cannot violate.
name: Extreme Morality

# Hatred

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 3 / 6 / 9 BP  
**Type**: Psychological

## Description
Deep prejudice, visceral loathing, or blood-feud hatred directed against a specific species, faction, or creed.

## Mechanics & Severity
### Tiers & Effects
- **Minor (3 BP)**: Disgust & Prejudice. `-2` to all Social checks with target group.
- **Moderate (6 BP)**: Loathing. Must pass a **Will Save (DC 15)** to assist, heal, or cooperate with them.
- **Major (9 BP)**: Violent animosity. Must pass a **Will Save (DC 18)** *not* to attack or sabotage them on sight.

# Honorable

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 3 / 6 / 9 BP  
**Type**: Psychological

## Description
Bound by an inflexible code of chivalry, bushido, rules of engagement, or strict honesty.

## Mechanics & Severity
### Tiers & Effects
- **Minor (3 BP)**: Gentlemanly conduct. Refuses to cheat at games or strike from behind.
- **Moderate (6 BP)**: Code of Honor. Won't attack an unarmed foe, won't tell deliberate lies, accepts formal surrenders.
- **Major (9 BP)**: Absolute Pacifism or Unbreakable Oath. Cannot break word or harm a living being even to save own life.

Lost Sense
description: Complete biological absence or destruction of one of the character's primary sensory channels.
body:
# Lost Sense

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 3 / 6 / 9 BP  
**Type**: Physical

## Description
Complete biological absence or destruction of one of the character's primary sensory channels.

## Mechanics & Severity
### Tiers & Effects
- **3 BP**: Total loss of **Taste or Smell**. Immune to scent-based nausea/gas sickness, but cannot smell toxins or smoke.
- **6 BP**: Total loss of **Touch (Numbness)** or **Hearing (Deafness)**. `-4` to fine Dexterity (if Numb) or auto-fail all acoustic checks (if Deaf).
- **9 BP**: Total loss of **Sight (Blindness)**. Automatically fails visual checks; 50% miss chance in combat unless using blind-fight/meta senses.

description: Neurodivergence, chronic amnesia, hallucinations, severe cognitive blocks, or traumatic brain injuries.
body:
# Mental Issues

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 3 / 6 / 9 / 12 BP  
**Type**: Mental

## Description
Neurodivergence, chronic amnesia, hallucinations, severe cognitive blocks, or traumatic brain injuries.

## Mechanics & Severity
### Tiers & Effects
- **Minor (3 BP)**: Mild distraction or fixation. `-2` to Concentration checks.
- **Moderate (6 BP)**: Stress confusion. Suffer **-2 penalty to all mental checks** when under duress.
- **Major (9 BP)**: Hallucinogenic / Dissociative. Suffer **-4 penalty to Perception**; struggles to distinguish reality from delusion.
- **Severe (12 BP)**: Catatonic / Paralyzing Anxiety. When triggered, character cannot initiate attacks or complex actions, taking only defensive actions.
name: Mental Issues

# Minority

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 2+ BP  
**Type**: Social

## Description
Belonging to an oppressed, feared, or heavily stigmatized demographic, species, or creed in the sector.

## Mechanics & Severity
### Mechanics
- Gains the **Xeno / Social Stigma** modifier.
- Prices for goods/services are 20-50% higher; law enforcement treats character with extreme suspicion; initial NPC reactions start as *Unfriendly* or *Hostile*.

# Mute

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 2 BP  
**Type**: Physical

## Description
Lacking vocal cords or biological capacity for verbal speech.

## Mechanics & Severity
### Mechanics
- Cannot speak aloud. Cannot cast invocations requiring Verbal components. Must communicate via sign language, datapad text, or telepathy.

# Nightmares

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 2 BP  
**Type**: Mental

## Description
Plagued by psychic echoes, traumatic memories, or horrifying supernatural dreams.

## Mechanics & Severity
### Mechanics
- After every Long Rest, roll **1d10**. On a **1**, the character suffers night terrors and gains **no benefit from the rest**, starting the day **Fatigued** (`-2` to all actions).

Starting with severe financial deficits, second-hand gear, or crushing loanshark debt.

Severe social awkwardness, abrasive personality, inability to read rooms, or notorious reputation.

## Mechanics & Severity

- **Minor (3 BP)**: Introverted/Shy. `-2` to Persuasion checks.

body:
# Technologically Impaired

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 10 / 20 / 30 BP  
**Type**: Mental / Background

## Description
Baffled by modern technology, computing devices, energy weapons, or automated starships.

## Mechanics & Severity
### Tiers & Effects
- **10 BP**: **-1 Tech Level**. Treats standard TL 3 tech as unfamiliar (-2 penalty).
- **20 BP**: **-2 Tech Level**. Struggles with basic industrial machinery (-4 penalty).
- **30 BP**: **-3 Tech Level (Luddite)**. Cannot operate computers, energy weapons, or starship controls without massive penalties.

name: Unlucky
description: A profound cosmic jinx that drains the character's pool of heroic luck and causes probability to work against them.
body:
# Unlucky

**Category**: Hindrances & Disadvantages  
**BP Granted**: 3 / 6 / 9 BP  
**Type**: Metaphysical / Karma

## Description
A profound cosmic jinx that drains the character's pool of heroic luck and causes probability to work against them.

## Mechanics & Severity
### Tiers & Effects
- **3 BP**: **-2 to Karma Pool** maximum.
- **6 BP**: **-4 to Karma Pool** maximum.
- **9 BP**: **-6 to Karma Pool** maximum. Drops character into **Karmic Debt**, granting the GM automatic complication triggers at the start of each session.
